fix.summary: classify_page_shell now reports "blocked" for a platform loading gate: body short (<=400 chars) AND a loading notice AND a page footer/legal stamp AND almost nothing left (<=8 content chars) once the notice and the footer are removed, with any sentence boundary in the pre-footer text vetoing the verdict. Detection runs on the page text with a reader tier's leading transport header (Title/URL Source/Published Time/Warning/Markdown Content) stripped, so a 54-char gate is not hidden by a 435-char header. _is_shell_payload also consults the classifier so the native read reports status "blocked" instead of a mislabelled generic extraction error.
